name: Space King
description: Hold block to sing for the Space King. When the song ends, a boss steps out on your side.

displayLines.label: Full charge: a co-op boss fights for you this round

details:
Hold block to charge (about 17 seconds at base stats, as long as growing a Sacred Grove circle and all 3 of its levels; you can't move or shoot while charging). Nothing happens while you charge except a light opera choir that others can hear.

When the charge is full, one of the co-op bosses (The Warden or The Storm Engine) steps out next to you and fights on your side until it dies or the round ends. It never comes back next round. Once per round.

Let go and the charge drains back, but not at once. Charging speed comes from Block cooldown and Block duration. No block bubble.
